rules: Every icd11_candidate is a candidate only: verify against the WHO ICD-11 MMS API before use; until verified, icd11_code stays empty.

terms.icd11_candidate: 3A9Z (as for dx.anaemia_unexplained; cause post-coordinated) — to verify
terms.why: 'Severe anaemia secondary to malaria' needs an anaemia term that does not say 'cause not yet known'. dx.anaemia_unexplained stays as the placeholder and refines to this term once a cause is linked. Severity is its stage (WHO 2024).
ACS refines to STEMI from the ECG (R3).

terms.icd11_candidate: no specific code; keep BA4Z as for dx.acs — to verify
terms.why: The ESC working diagnosis between the ECG and the troponin result. Without it, ACS would have to jump straight to NSTEMI or unstable angina before the troponin decides.
NSTE-ACS refines to NSTEMI when serial troponin rises or falls above the 99th percentile.
NSTE-ACS refines to unstable angina when serial troponin does not rise.

terms.display: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
terms.why: Heart failure refines by LVEF on echo; class decides the medicine-review prompts later.

terms.display: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF)
Heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction (HFmrEF)
terms.why: Only if the CSO keeps the 2021 three-class scheme; the 2026 ESC guideline removed it.

terms.icd11_candidate: CA40.Z; no distinct community-acquired code found — to verify
terms.why: Setting of acquisition changes the expected organisms and the antibiotic protocol (R3).

terms.icd11_candidate: CA40.Z with a healthcare-associated extension code, if MMS offers one — to verify
terms.why: As above; also counts as a healthcare-associated infection for IPC surveillance.
Hypertensive crisis refines by acute organ damage; must match the hypertension pack's acute route (D-HTN-01).

terms.display: Severe hypertension without acute organ damage
terms.icd11_candidate: BA03.0 'hypertensive urgency' — to verify; the display deliberately avoids 'urgency' (D-REL-16)
terms.why: So that very high BP without organ damage is named honestly and is not treated as an emergency.
The meningitis refinement needs an end point for a lymphocytic CSF once bacterial, cryptococcal and TB causes are excluded.
